rationale: Repeated stratified and full-resolution review found systematic smoke-only, broadcast-overlay, boundary-artifact, or ambiguous-fire annotations in sibling augmentations from these source families.
known_limitations: This conservative family-level rule removes some visually acceptable records together with their unreliable siblings.
The rule is based on single-reviewer enriched-sample adjudication and is not an estimated whole-dataset error rate.
Original images, labels, and all earlier manifest versions remain unchanged.
